snippet.title: WINDWEAVER - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Windweaver is a fast-paced action platformer where you harness the power of the wind to run faster, jump farther, and chain momentum into high-speed combos. 

Experience fluid movement, slope physics, and precision platforming as you race to reclaim your lost power and uncover the secrets of your world!

💬 JOIN THE DISCORD: discord.gg/EzJgdtCVK5
🌐 WEBSITE: windweaver.xyz
